environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) with no internet gateway or NAT gateway attached. Service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint policy restricts access to principals within the organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). The endpoint's security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) permits inbound TCP/443 only from CIDR 10.0.0.0/20 (internal application subnet). There is no public DNS resolution for the service; the only resolvable hostname is the VPC endpoint DNS name (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890-abcdefgh.session-svc.us-east-1.vpce.amazonaws.com). Route tables for the private subnet contain no route to an internet gateway. The NLB target group has connection idle timeout of 60 seconds.

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in private subnet (no IGW, no NAT)
config.internet_route: none (no IGW, no NAT in route table)
